# Aqua Pool (`aqua-pool`)

Style of `professional-apple-ui`. Pick ONE per project, record it in the project's `AGENTS.md` (`UI style: aqua-pool`) and in `docs/ui-style.json`, and generate `Theme.swift` from it; never mix styles.

**Feel**: Clean and refreshing: turquoise hero, for health, water and travel apps.

**Source of the values**: **computed**: generated by `make_style.py` from the brand hue with the OKLCH recipe calibrated on Mint Studio, then pushed until every reading pair reaches WCAG AA.

## Type and shape

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Font design | `rounded` |
| Corner radii (hero / card / tile / thumbnail) | 28 / 24 / 16 / 14 pt |
| Role hues (OKLCH) | brand 195°, info 255°, plan 300°, attention 55°, danger 25° |
